title: Right step in merging
statement: Let $l$ and $r$ be lists of integers and let $i,j$ be natural numbers with $i<|l|$ and $j<|r|$. If the $j$th entry of $r$ is strictly less than the $i$th entry of $l$, then merging the tails beginning at indices $i$ and $j$ gives the $j$th entry of $r$ followed by the merge of the unchanged tail of $l$ beginning at $i$ with the tail of $r$ beginning at $j+1$.
